android.desc:
Faidepro is a free B2B business app in India that assists users to simply communicate with Buyers, Sellers, Manufacturers, Wholesalers, Suppliers, Affiliate Marketers & Social Media Influencers around the globe within one app. Faidepro provides each facility to the users, and with that, they can connect with the whole supply chain and tie-up with both national and international businesses without spending any penny. That means Faidepro has a B2B and B2C marketplace with easy connection facilities. Users can reach the right community and connect with them with one magic click. Faidepro introduces user's business and also helps to grow their business profile.  

Users can now both launch their products and define their services using a single Faidepro app. Faidepro provides users free of cost business promotion and advertising platform. Users can make an attractive digital business portfolio with Faidepro’s advanced features.

Faidepro connects users with their community of interest. Instant notification of each update is one of the finest features for all businesses which are connected. An added feature is that users can send a connection request to multiple communities at a time. For communicating with any other businessmen and sharing your portfolio, without spending any money on the platform.

Reasons To Use Faidepro

- Digital Business Portfolio
- Connect to multiple business in one click of request
- Get you all customer updated with your services and product with one notification
- Zero Commission app
- Share Button For Sharing Business Update on Every Social Media Platform
-Free Messaging & Chatting with File Sharing

B2B & B2C: How it’s useful

- Add Services and Products: Faidepro already has 250+ services and products on the platform, users can choose their business categories.

- Affiliate marketer: Faidepro has 100+ Affiliate marketers.

- Find & Build your community: With the search of users interested in the community, they reach up to them and simply introduce their business.

- Easy communication: With Faidepro users can start communicating with other businesses with one magic click. Users connect, chat and share any details with their business community without spending any money.

- Business connectivity: Users outreach their business to many more businesses and digitally grow business.

- Free of cost marketing: With launching their products and services on Faidepro, users also facilitated free of cost marketing
